D/ CONSTANTINVS[---]C ; R/ BEATA TRAN QVILLITAS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Beata Tranquillitas issue of Trier mint of 321, RIC vol. 7 page 192 no. 334, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate mantled and holding globe ?and sceptre? left. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS[---]C. Reverse description: globe on altar inscribed VO/TIS/XX, three stars above. Reverse inscription: BEATA TRAN QVILLITAS.…
